title: Vesper and the Bridge
author: X. M. Almeida
blurb: Dominic Nakamura, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
